lines.lyric_translation: At the end of this road that couldn’t be seen
The times I didn’t know
The feelings you gave to me
That comforted me like a young child

lines.lyric: Naege jweotteon maeumi areumdapge pigo isseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 내게 줬던 마음이 아름답게 피고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: Embracing me warmly, they are now blooming beautifully
You, who were always smiling
I can see you clearly
I hope all of it
Can become precious memories
The star that shined on me
I’ll look after your place for you

lines.lyric: Ijen neowa na hangsang bichi nal su itge
lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 너와 나 항상 빛이 날 수 있게
lines.lyric_translation: So that you and I can shine all the time from now on

lines.lyric: Nae soneul jaba du mameul moa
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 손을 잡아 두 맘을 모아
lines.lyric_translation: Take my hand, let’s join our hearts together
Call me with all your strength

lines.lyric: Uril balkyeo jul neomu areumdaun bit
lines.lyric_hangul: 우릴 밝혀 줄 너무 아름다운 빛
lines.lyric_translation: The beautiful light that will shine on us

lines.lyric: Dan hanaye byeol Be as one
lines.lyric_hangul: 단 하나의 별 be as one
lines.lyric_translation: The one-of-a-kind star, be as one
The ‘me’ of tomorrow I dreamed of / (The ‘me’ of the future)
Even if it looks a bit different / (Even if I can’t see what’s in front of me)

lines.lyric: Niga isseo gwaenchana ijen seulpeodo ulji ana
lines.lyric_hangul: 니가 있어 괜찮아 이젠 슬퍼도 울지 않아
lines.lyric_translation: It’s okay because you’re here, I won’t cry anymore even if I’m sad

lines.lyric: Ni gyeoteseon naega dashi useul su isseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 니 곁에선 내가 다시 웃을 수 있어
lines.lyric_translation: When I’m next to you I can smile again
When I imagine you
Who are smiling to your heart’s content
I hope my feelings
Of wanting to give you absolutely everything reach you
The star that shined on me
I’ll look after your place for you

lines.lyric: Ijen neowa na hangsang bichi nal su itge
lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 너와 나 항상 빛이 날 수 있게
lines.lyric_translation: So that you and I can shine all the time from now on

lines.lyric: Nae soneul jaba du mameul moa
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 손을 잡아 두 맘을 모아
lines.lyric_translation: Take my hand, let’s join our hearts together
Call me with all your strength

lines.lyric: Uril balkyeo jul neomu areumdaun bit
lines.lyric_hangul: 우릴 밝혀 줄 너무 아름다운 빛
lines.lyric_translation: The beautiful light that will shine on us
The one-of-a-kind star, because it’s you

lines.lyric: Micheo mollatteon naege daeun sojunghan neoya
lines.lyric_hangul: 미처 몰랐던 내게 닿은 소중한 너야
lines.lyric_translation: When I didn’t know anything, the precious you reached me

lines.lyric: Ganjikaedulkke urideure shigan naye himi dweyeo jweo
lines.lyric_hangul: 간직해둘게 우리들의 시간 나의 힘이 되어 줘
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll cherish the time we have together

lines.lyric: Nawa hamkke georeo jweo nareul mideo jweo
lines.lyric_hangul: 나와 함께 걸어 줘 나를 믿어 줘
lines.lyric_translation: Become my strength, walk with me, trust me
I’ll always be together with you, by your side
My heart is only for you
I’ll be with you just like I am now

lines.lyric: Naye mamiya nae ane neol ganjikalkke
lines.lyric_hangul: 나의 맘이야 내 안에 널 간직할게
lines.lyric_translation: That’s how I feel, I’ll cherish you within me

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 손을 잡아 두 맘을 모아
lines.lyric_translation: Take my hand, let’s join our hearts together
